in_sanskrit.name: चिन्तना
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is engaged in deep thought or contemplation

in_marathi.name: Chinthana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chinthana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chinthana is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chintana' meaning 'thought' or 'reflection'. It is a name that signifies deep introspection and contemplation. In Hindu mythology, Chinthana is considered a feminine name and is associated with the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom.
